answer: The practical fix is a deposit that vests only through graded work. Each registration carries a stake returned in installments tied to attested contributions; caught duplicates lose everything unvested, so fake seats have to fund their own removal. In effect the jade of free entry disappears, the ledge of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the pulse case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Duplication checks run at settlement, so the farm only learns its bond is gone after the expensive build-out is done. That flips the unit economics: authentic agents get cheaper.
